_: ONE table, read by both readers of the Backlog's rows (docs/hub/milestones.md, "The Backlog: the order as a table"). A milestone is a group when a card in backlog/ names it; inside a group every member is a row -- a card in current/ too, in its place, in_play true -- so the ranks read 1, 2, 3. A card in current/ with no milestone, or whose milestone has no waiting card, is no row. Groups go milestone by milestone: milestones that have a file -- milestones/<slug of the title>.md whose # heading names the title exactly -- by the file's **Created:** day (a file with none after the dated ones), ties by title; then milestones with no file, by title (ordinal). Inside a group: the order's ranked ids, then its unranked ones (milestone-order.json's rule). Then the cards in backlog/ with no milestone: oldest **Created:** first, no date last, ties by id (ordinal). rank is the card's place among the milestone's ranked ids, 1-based, the same count Plan -Rank uses; null when unranked. title and type come from the card's # heading (a configured type name, any id, a colon; an emoji first is dropped); no known type is type "" and the whole heading is the title. age is whole days from **Created:** to today, 0 for a future day, null for no date or an impossible one. filter: milestone and type match ignoring case (type ignoring spaces too, so userstory is User Story), tag is one of the card's tags ignoring case; filters AND, and a filtered row keeps its rank. Each case's files are joined with LF, or CRLF when crlf is true. typeNames and prefixes are the shipped workItemTypes in config order. Scripts/Read-Backlog.ps1 Get-P20BacklogRows (tkTestToolkit -Backlog) and agent/core/parsers.py backlog_rows() (Tests/test_backlog.py).

cases.name: milestones with a file first, by their Created; then the rest by title; then no milestone
ranked by the file, then unranked by created; a card in play is a row in its ranked place, marked in play
a stale id, and a card naming another milestone, are skipped: the rank counts live ids only
a file whose heading names another milestone, or that is not at the title's slug, is no file
milestone files with the same Created go by title, and a file with no Created comes after the dated ones
no milestone: oldest first, ties by id, no date last; an impossible date has no age, a future one is 0
type and title from the heading: a heading with no known type has none, an emoji is dropped; an old card's Sprint line is its milestone
filter by milestone, ignoring case: the rank stays the milestone's
filter by tag: one of the card's tags, ignoring case
filter by type, ignoring case and spaces
a filter nothing matches: no rows
CRLF: a card and a milestone file read the same
a card in play the order does not list is unranked and in play; a card in play with no milestone is no row
a milestone whose cards are all in play is no group; only cards in play: no rows
